Marissa, thanks again for the demo earlier — quick follow-up from our side with the numbers we discussed so you can surface pricing to your team.

Recap of our expected usage (initial 6-12 months):
- Chat (customer support assistant): ~120M input+output tokens / month (~40% of total tokens)
- Embeddings (semantic search + rerank): ~90M embedding units / month (~30%)
- Rerank / fine-grained scoring (short requests): ~30M tokens / month (~10%)
- System prompts / metadata / logs (overhead): ~60M tokens / month (~20%)

Total: ~300M tokens / month.

Budget: target OPEX ~ $2,500 - $5,000 / month initially; willing to pilot larger if unit economics justify.

1) Target $/1M tokens across our model mix (chat vs embeddings vs rerank).
2) Any bulk discounts or committed tiers for predictable volume.
3) Latency SLOs for chat (p95 < 350ms for short chats) and embedding throughput.

Happy to hop on another 30-min call if you want to walk through the numbers.

Subject: Pricing workbook + pilot proposal (call tomorrow 10am PT)

Samir — attaching the workbook and a short pilot proposal (see attached SOW draft). High level notes below and two pricing representations so you can see unit economics: per-model $/1M tokens, and blended cost at your stated mix.

Per-model guidance (pilot / committed):
- Chat (conservative gen model): $38 / 1M tokens (pilot). Committed tiers from $28–$22 / 1M depending on 6/12 month commit and reserved capacity.
- Embeddings (1536-dim): $12 / 1M embedding units (pilot). Committed $9–$6 / 1M.
- Rerank / scoring (small/chat-optimized): $20 / 1M tokens (pilot). Committed $15–$10 / 1M.

Your stated mix blended estimate (pilot rates):
- Chat 40% => 120M tokens * $38/1M = $4,560
- Embeddings 30% => 90M units * $12/1M = $1,080
- Rerank 10% => 30M tokens * $20/1M = $600
- Overhead 20% => 60M tokens * averaged $30/1M = $1,800

Estimated pilot monthly bill: ~$8,040. With a 12-month committed tier and reserved capacity these numbers drop to approx $4k–$5k / month depending on exact commit and usage smoothing (details in workbook).

Recommendations to meet your $2.5k–$5k target:
- Start with a 3-month pilot at pilot rates to validate quality and latency.
- Commit to a 6-12 month reserved tier at month 2 if usage stabilizes — this moves you into the $9–$22/1M windows and hits your $4k–$5k goal.
- Use prefix caching and a shorter chat model for short replies to bring chat cost down (Rishi / Dev can help tune).

Agenda for tomorrow's 10am PT call: review workbook, confirm embedding unit assumptions, discuss commit tiers and SOW.

Thanks — attached: redwood-pricing-estimate.xlsx, BrightLayer-SOW-draft.pdf

Best,
Marissa
